<caption>Live database verification at 15:07 London, 30 October 2026. These are overlapping physical storage counts, not complete dataset coverage.</caption>

I independently confirmed that the three repairs from <Link url="https://github.com/robert8p/Alpaca-Supabase-Populator/commit/d06c13f30a0bed8da6366f124101b59d21a450fa">revision `d06c13f`</Link> are installed: both maintenance task indexes are valid and ready, and the readback function excludes pages committed in its current transaction. The approved authentication function remains unchanged.

**A fresh failure at 15:00 identifies continued lock contention.** Two PostgreSQL `55P03` failures occurred at 15:00:03 and 15:00:05, with both waiters blocked by PID `1253575`. The existing cron 602 monitor ran for 8.48 seconds across this interval. Earlier failures have proven monitor ownership; the exact holder-to-cron PID association for this particular occurrence has not yet been independently established.

The existing implementation owner retains its verified lease through **15:45 London**. I preserved that ownership, performed no competing production changes and left the worker running. A direct diagnostic handoff was attempted but the notification service rejected it; I have not claimed delivery to the controller.

**Status: RUNNING — 5,409 pages verified, sustained reliability not yet established, full 16-family backfill incomplete.** The remaining engineering priority is bounded measurement and correction of maintenance time spent holding the shared advisory lock. The existing implementation automation remains enabled without a programme deadline.
